reschedule.q: How do I cancel or reschedule an appointment?
reschedule.a: Open <link>Bookings</link>, choose the appointment and tap Reschedule or Cancel. Each business sets its own cancellation window — you'll see exactly what applies, including any fee or refund, before you confirm.

refund.q: When will I get my refund?
refund.a: Refunds go back to the card you paid with as soon as a cancellation is confirmed. Depending on your bank, they usually take 5–10 business days to appear. Whether a deposit is refundable depends on the business's policy, which is shown when you book.

contactPro.q: How do I contact a professional?
contactPro.a: Use Message on their profile or on your booking. Your conversations live in <link>Messages</link>. For anything about the service itself — directions, preparation, what to bring — the business can answer fastest.

report.q: Something went wrong with a business. What can I do?
report.a: Open a request below and choose “Report a business”. Link the appointment if there is one. We read every report, and we can step in on refunds and, where needed, remove businesses from Kept.

account.q: How do I change my email or delete my account?
account.a: Email changes go through support so we can confirm it's you. You can download your data or delete your account yourself in <link>Privacy & data</link>.
